title: Modimola Village, Mahikeng (village only, approx.): man, 37, stabbed dead, 17 Oct

story: SAPS says a 37-year-old man was stabbed at Modimola Village, Mmabatho, at about 04:00 on Saturday 17 October. A woman told police a 22-year-old family member came home at about 03:00 and broke the window of the room where she and the man were sleeping; the man went outside to confront him and they fought. She went to neighbours for help and, on returning, found him on the ground with stab wounds; paramedics declared him dead. A 22-year-old suspect was arrested and is expected in the Mmabatho Magistrate's Court on a murder charge. The same police statement reported the Seweding killing that night; police say the two are unrelated.
location_note: Modimola Village, west of Mahikeng, named by SAPS. No street or house is given. The pin is OpenStreetMap's point for Modimola.

provenance.statement_from: SAPS North West: an 18 Oct statement covering both Mmabatho killings
provenance.note: Both carry the 18 Oct SAPS statement that also covers the Seweding killing. Police say the two are unrelated, so the pins are separate and not linked.
